supplement_note: Added only notice-072 LENDUSDT closure-month query. Earlier 72 queries were not repeated. Notice IDs and their queried effective dates are unchanged.

boundary_bar_detail.interpretation: An hourly bar beginning at settlement can contain a terminal observation. Positive volume is not proof of tradability for the full hour.

facts_binding_note: Digest binds the expanded facts attachment including 12 snapshot episode reviews. Original query fact IDs and effective timestamps remain unchanged. The interpretation of notice-055 is corrected by the recovered cancellation. Only two new notice-134 closure-month queries were added; earlier market queries were not rerun.
boundary_caveat: These are comparisons to announced settlement START or stated trading cessation, not measured completion. Do not automatically discard funding immediately after that timestamp: LENDUSDT has an observation at boundary + 5 ms, which may be a terminal payment. Nor does a positive-volume boundary bar establish tradability for the full hour. No row has been adjudicated as valid cashflow or invalid source data by this count alone.

summary.selected_file_count_kind: unique files across closure-month queries; prior AERGO detail reread one selected file

snapshot_episode_screen.scope: Read published membership and bar manifest only; compare earliest declared monthly bar partition against snapshot onboard month. No market-bar rows read, no date inferred from first bar. This screen cannot detect reuse inside the same calendar month.
snapshot_episode_screen.review_disposition: All 12 flags classified in facts.snapshot_episode_reviews. Nine closure/relaunch histories, two different-underlying ticker reuses, and one launch/snapshot-onboard discrepancy. Remaining 686 snapshot rows are not thereby proved complete; same-month reuse is outside this screen.
